articles.title: Letters: Linden Road Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Linden Road use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Linden Road for 10 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foxglove Heights Neighbors has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Albert Brennan, Hickory Ridge

articles.title: Hannah Wojcik, 80, Bus Driver
articles.deck: Friends remember Hannah Wojcik for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Hannah Wojcik died in April at home on Salem Street, at the age of 80.

Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing.
Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Hannah Wojcik spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
